wholePhysicalScope: Mapped tower and attached café outlines, the September 2011 Qualla original, and 26 metre height and red granite verified by Tampere Tourism and the Finnish Heritage Agency.
lodDetails: Four detail levels retain the red granite shaft, upper window openings, cornices, viewing deck and mapped café outline. Near levels add window surrounds, individual frames and shaft apertures.
limitations: The model represents the tower and café in September 2011. The nearby freestanding radio mast and park buildings are outside its scope.
The upper window and skyline details are constrained by the distant cleared photo; the window count and spacing, tower taper, parapet and stair headhouse dimensions are approximations.
The present mapped café outline stands in for its unverified 2011 outline. Its roof construction, elevations, openings and paths are estimates.
Original raster relief shows the general ridge grade; the visual building foundation is not a survey.
